summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long LWLG Daily ETF (LWLX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to deliver 200% leveraged exposure to the daily share price movements of Lightwave Logic, Inc. (NASDAQ: LWLG), net of fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements. LWLX was launched on Aug 17, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
